sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.6 "Ethernet functional description: PHY interfaces" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2206.
sections.section_content:
The Ethernet peripheral support several PHY interfaces. The root interface is the MII one.
All other interfaces are derived from it as shown in Figure718.
[Figure 718. Supported PHY interfaces]
This section describes the SMA module used for PHY control and different PHY interfaces.
It contains the following sections:
• Station management agent (SMA)
• Media independent interface (MII)
• Reduced media independent interface (RMII)
